summary: No new evidence or change this cycle; the draft bytes stand as previously accepted rather than becoming a duplicate revision. Final state of this run's record: one asserted, independently witnessed defect (shouldSnapshot's unsigned delta underflow makes a store-emptied node report that it should snapshot, re-creating a snapshot at an unchanged index, CheckRun 9cba2e79ff6c4019b0f0381690d9aaab), whose reachability was then narrowed by measurement (the user-restore producer refuted, CheckRun b78bcab64b0d41b5adaafa98cc0c7f43); three refuted suspicions with retained operands (non-voter commit eligibility; post-restart vote duplication, which also demonstrated the durable last vote; AddVoter configuration lag as a bounded transient); and three durable Behaviors/Facts covering leader append-time configuration/commitment updates, follower latest-configuration-at-store-time, voter-only commit eligibility, and durable last-vote reads. The only unfinished item is the snapshot-install producer on a follower, which still needs its own fixed experiment.
